name: improve
summary: The empty-queue policy: when nothing is queued, turns only measured problems (a repeat failure, a missed target, a failing smoke test found by the bug sweep) into a few capped ticket candidates with evidence, and closes them only on a before/after reading it takes itself.

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (reads state/failure-register.md and state/targets.json, writes state/improve-candidates.jsonl, improve-readings.jsonl, improve.tick; bug_sweep.py reads state/projects.json and writes state/bugsweep/NAME.txt, bugsweep-covered.jsonl, bug-sweep.tick)
env.LEDGER_PATH: optional: use this ledger file instead of $HUBKIT_HOME/state/ledger.jsonl

needs: the ledger pattern installed next to it
